title: Greer's 2001 National Press Club whistleblower panel

tellings.quote: Yeah, this was in 2001 and he hosted a panel of whistleblowers

plain: In 2001 a UFO activist named Steven Greer held a panel of whistleblowers, people who said they had inside knowledge of government secrets about UFOs, at the National Press Club in Washington. An online UFO researcher who goes by UAPGerb mentions it on the show without naming a source, and links it to a 2001 disclosure briefing document and to one of the speakers, an aerospace illustrator named Mark McCandlish. The point of telling it is that insiders were going public on the record two decades before the recent hearings.
